content: There has been significant progress on Named Entity Recognition (NER) in recent years using models based on machine learning algorithms BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 . As with other Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks, building NER systems typically requires a massive amount of labeled training data which are annotated by experts. In real applications, we often need to consider new types of entities in new domains where we do not have existing annotated data. For such new types of entities, however, it is very hard to find experts to annotate the data within short time limits and hiring experts is costly and non-scalable, both in terms of time and money.
